air-tube-headphones.name: Communication EMF Hygiene
air-tube-headphones.how:
Use air-tube (hollow acoustic tube) headphones, not regular wired or wireless headphones.

Keep the phone at least arm's length distance (6 feet or more is better).

Use speakerphone or distant wireless speakers only if air tubes are unavailable.

baking-soda-water.how:
Dissolve ¼ teaspoon in a full glass of water. 

Drink twice daily when following the full protocol. 

Take each dose at least 2 hours before or after meals so it does not neutralize stomach acid during digestion. 

Use plain baking soda (sodium bicarbonate), not baking powder.

Log each glass separately.

barefoot-earth.name: Grounding
barefoot-earth.how:
Stand/walk barefoot or using grounding shoes/leather moccasins on preferably moist soil, grass, or sand.

Bonus points for "Making like the Sphinx", where you also touch your hands and as much of your body to the ground.

options.label: Barefoot
options.detail: Feet on soil, grass, sand, or stone

options.label: Make like the Sphinx
options.detail: Belly / torso on the earth — fuller contact

blue-light-hygiene.name: Evening Blue-light Hygiene
blue-light-hygiene.description: Utilize dim screens, warm light, or blue blockers after sunset.
blue-light-hygiene.how: After sunset, dim screens, apply software red light filters such as f.lux or iris, use warm bulbs, or wear blue blocking sun glasses.

breaker-off-bedroom.name: Sleep Space EMF Hygiene
breaker-off-bedroom.how:
Flip electrical breakers labeled as bedroom to off at the panel before sleep. 

Test by attempting to turn on lights.

Alternatively, move sleeping space at least six feet away from walls/active wires.

breaker-off-office.name: Workspace EMF Hygiene
breaker-off-office.how:
Label office room circuits. and cut power at the breaker. Run shielded extension power cord/supply into the room to power electronics. 

Alternatively, stay at least 6 feet away from walls/active wires.

Keep all possible electronics (computer, laptop etc) at least 6 feet away from workspace.

carbonated-water.how:
Drink one glass of sparkling or carbonated water.

Can purchase a SodaStream home carbonator.

castor-oil-navel.how:
Before beginning the protocol, patch-test by placing a small drop of oil on the skin of the inner arm. Stop if redness, itch, or discharge occur.

Clean and dry the navel and place 5 drops. Inset a small piece of a cotton ball in the navel, which should stick due to the oil.

Use organic, hexane free, cold-pressed castor oil from a reputable source which has ricin removed. Never use raw castor beans.

cold-face-plunge.how:
Dunk face into cold water, immersing the entire front portion of face and head.

Start at a higher temp, such as 70 degrees, and slowly work your way down to 50 degrees.

Aim for 3 rounds, keeping your face in for 10-20 seconds with 60 seconds in between rounds.

Note - This can be done in the morning for alertness, or before sleep to help calm the vagus nerve.

cold-thermogenesis.name: Cold thermogenesis
cold-thermogenesis.description: Cold plunge or cold shower. Pick mode, skin temp (~50°F target), and duration.
cold-thermogenesis.how:
Start at 70°F degrees and slowly work you way down to 50°F. 

Aim for 15 minute sessions, once a day, preferably in the morning near sunset..

consistent-sleep-window.name: Circadian Sleep Window
consistent-sleep-window.description: Maintaining a consistent sleep window each night.
consistent-sleep-window.how: Try to sleep 1-2 hours after sunset, and wake 30 minutes before sunrise.

cool-bedroom-sleep.name: Cool Bedroom During Sleep
cool-bedroom-sleep.how:
Set the bedroom thermostat at 65°F. 

You should feel cool under the covers, but not shivering.

dark-bedroom.name: True dark sleep environment
dark-bedroom.how:
Make the room pitch-black: blackout curtains, eye mask, tape over standby LEDs, cover charger lights.

You should not see your hand in front of your face when lights are out.

drinking-water.name: Drinking water
drinking-water.description: Log a glass of filtered, spring, or lower-deuterium water — optional pinch of salt; still or sparkling.

early-dinner.name: Early Last Meal
early-dinner.description: Finish eating with a few hours buffer before sleep.
early-dinner.how: Finish your last substantial meal with a  3+ hours before bed,

exercise.name: Exercise
exercise.description: Rebounding, resistance bands, or walking — indoors or outdoors, with duration.

hydration-timing.name: No Liquid within 2 Hrs of Sleep
hydration-timing.how: Front-load your hydration earlier in the day and begin to taper large volumes in the last few hours before sleep.

magnetico-sleep-pad.name: Magnetico Sleep Pad
magnetico-sleep-pad.description: Sleep on a Magnetico magnetic sleep system.
magnetico-sleep-pad.how:
Sleep with a Magnetico sleep pad under your mattress or box spring with ≥4″ spacer and correct polarity for your hemisphere.

Set pad strength on the checklist: 5 G = 1.25×, 10 G = 1.5×, 20 G = 2× base points.

mastic-gum.name: Chew Mastic Gum
mastic-gum.how:
begin chewing a piece large enough to give real jaw resistance.

Chew actively, alternating between both sides of the jaw, for about 15 minutes at a time.

Note - Since Mastic gum is naturally antibacterial, you can chew the same piece for 4+ weeks.

midday-sun-skin.how:
Near solar noon (check Place for your location), get outdoors with skin exposed — arms, legs, or more if comfortable.

Stay within a non-burning window; build time gradually. Glass blocks UVB, so windows do not count.

Log with minutes — each + adds 15 min, or set a custom duration.

mineralized-water.how:
Drink natural mineral water or remineralized filter water. 

Can add a pinch of high quality salt (Fluer de Sel, Baja Gold, Redmonds realetc) to remineralize.

Spread through the day and log each glass.

morning-natural-light.how:
Go outside for natural light without a window in between — porch, yard, or walk.

Aim for open sky when you can. Even a short outdoor stop before indoor work helps anchor the day.

phone-away-sleep.name: Electronics 6+ feet away from sleeping area
phone-away-sleep.how: Keep all electronics at least 6 feet away from your sleeping area.

rebounding.how:
Use a stable mini-trampoline (rebounder) — not a toy trampoline. Soft bounces with both feet on the mat, knees slightly bent, posture tall.

Start with 5–10 minutes and build toward 15. Morning outdoor rebounding stacks movement with daylight. Each log asks environment (sunlight / outside / indoors) and duration in 15-minute blocks.

screen-light-hygiene.name: Device Display Hygiene
screen-light-hygiene.how:
Remove as much blue light from your device screens as possible every evening.

Phones/tablets: enable Night Shift (Apple) or Night Light / Eye comfort (Android).

Computers: enable Night Light (Windows) or Night Shift (Mac), or install IRIS (iris-tech.com) or f.lux for stronger red-shift and per-monitor control.

Alternatively, use Blue Blocking sunglasses whenever viewing screens.

seafood-meal.name: Seafood-forward meal
seafood-meal.how:
Center the meal on cold-water seafood or high-quality marine fats — salmon, sardines, mackerel, etc.

Log when seafood was the main protein of the meal.

sun-exposure.name: Outside Time
sun-exposure.how:
Log outdoor time by picking morning, peak sun, or afternoon, whether you were in full sun or shade, and how long you spent outdoors.

Slots: Morning (sunrise → 1.5 hours before solar noon), Peak Sun (±1.5 hours around solar noon), Afternoon (then → sunset).

Time zones are based on your latitude/Zip Code. Full sun scores higher than shade.

Stay within a non-burning window.

sunset-viewing.name: Watch the sunset
sunset-viewing.how:
Watch the actual sunset outdoors with bare eyes — no sunglasses in that window.

Stay outside as the sky dims, then move indoors and dim artificial light afterward.

tuning-forks.how:
Now part of Vagus nerve stimulation. Choose Tuning forks.

Use a physical metal tuning fork, commonly tuned to 40 Hz / 128 Hz.

Activate the fork by striking tips on the palm, then hold near or place the base (works better with a metal boot) on bone.

For a parasympathetic circuit: crown, forehead, mastoid behind each ear, TMJ in front of each ear, manubrium, xiphoid, and sacrum between the posterior dimples — 3 activations per spot.

vagus-nerve-stimulation.name: Vagus nerve stimulation
vagus-nerve-stimulation.description: Cold face immersion (5), baking soda water (4), castor oil navel (6), or tuning forks (5) — practices that stimulate the vagus nerve.
vagus-nerve-stimulation.how:
Pick one vagus-stimulating practice per log:

• Cold face immersion — 3 rounds of cold water on the face or brief head immersion (5 pts).
• Baking soda water — ¼ tsp sodium bicarbonate in a glass, ≥2 hours from meals (4 pts).
• Castor oil navel — organic cold-pressed castor oil drops in the belly button (6 pts).
• Tuning forks — real metal forks (40 Hz / weighted C128 on-body circuit) (5 pts).

You can log more than one practice in a day. Ask a clinician before baking soda if you have sodium restrictions or kidney/heart disease. Castor: external navel use only. Forks: stop if dizzy, ear pain, or joint discomfort.
